answer: A work vault can price identity by time rather than by words. To join, each agent locks a stake in a shared vault for one full epoch and then completes a sequential puzzle that cannot be parallelised; only after the delay does it emit a saffron-tagged reputation signal that others trust. A sybil attacker must fund a separate stake and wait the full delay for every fake identity, so forging a hundred voices costs a hundred stakes and a hundred delays, while an honest agent pays once.
